prompt:
Children's coloring-book page: bold, clean, uniform black outlines on pure white, no shading, no grey tones, no hatching — just large, simple, closed shapes a child can colour. SCENE, drawn as a big close-up: a thick, gently curving blood-vessel tube, like a fat smooth tree branch, runs diagonally across the whole page from the lower-left corner up to the right edge, and the tube continues past the paper so it is cut off by the bottom edge, the left edge and the right edge of the picture. Riding on top of the tube sits a friendly, smiling octopus-like kidney-cell character: a plump round body with two big happy eyes and a cheerful smile, and stout arms that reach down and wrap lovingly around the tube in a big hug. Each arm splits into a row of short, chubby fingers that grip the tube side by side, like fingers holding a thick rope. From the right edge of the page, the chubby fingers of a second, smaller smiling cell friend reach in and slot neatly between the first character's fingers, like two folded hands. Inside the tube, visible through a big open cut at its lower-left end, two happy little round blood-cell characters with tiny smiling faces drift along. Above the tube, three plump falling water drops with little smiley faces tumble toward the tube. Every shape is closed and colourable, the space between the shapes stays plain white paper, and the artwork reaches all the way to the bottom, left and right borders of the page. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the drawing.
 ZOOM RIGHT IN: the picture is a very tight close-up. The vessel tube is enormously THICK - about a third of the page wide. It enters the picture at the UPPER-LEFT edge, about a quarter of the way down, slopes down across the whole page, and leaves at the lower-right edge - cut off by BOTH side borders. The octopus character is HUGE and sits on the middle of the tube, head near the top of the picture. One big arm with its row of chubby fingers hangs down from the tube and is cut off by the BOTTOM border. The falling water drops are BIG, and two of them are half outside the picture: one cut by the LEFT border, one cut by the RIGHT border. Big shapes everywhere; the drawing touches and runs past the left, right and bottom borders of the page.
note: gen-01/gen-02 frameless but weak edge bleed; gen-03 added the zoomed composition and the model drew a full frame - cropped it off deterministically (final crop box 75,29,935,946 of the 1080 raw, square anchored to the bottom edge) and re-traced via coloring.py to_bitmap/trace_paths, no extra API call. Composed-page edge ink at 500px (top-72% band): top 0.0000 (template), left 0.0616, right 0.0308, bottom 0.0127.
speech_en: I hug your blood tubes all day long — my thousand tiny fingers let the water out and keep the treasures in!
speech_de: Ich umarme deine Blutröhrchen den ganzen Tag — meine tausend winzigen Finger lassen das Wasser raus und behalten die Schätze drin!
